2126058663169122505.en_summary: Scaling into pullbacks requires strict mathematical discipline. Charles Harris builds positions near support zones by setting explicit target average cost limits before entering. If additions pull the average cost out of line, the entry stops. Manage the average, control the risk.
2126058663169122505.zh_summary: 逐步加倉於回調需要嚴格的數學紀律。Charles Harris在支撑區域附近建立倉位，透過在進場前設定明確的目標平均成本限制。如果加倉使平均成本超出範圍，則停止進場。管理平均成本，控制風險。
